source: Mmhh… Morning, Yoshi~
translation: 嗯唔……早上好，Yoshi～

source: Ah, I’m glad you two are awake.
translation: 啊，很高兴你们两个都醒了。

source: Sheesh, Gramps! You startled me!
translation: 真是的，Gramps！你吓到我了！

source: Did I interrupt your cuddle session, lovebirds?
translation: 我打断你们两个小情侣亲热了吗？

source: You’re dressed up so early, Gramps. Headed somewhere?
translation: 这么早就穿戴整齐了，Gramps。要去哪里？

source: Yes, I have some urgent business to take care of at the city hall and I’m already running late.
translation: 是的，我有些急事要去市政厅处理，而且已经快迟到了。

source: I can drive for you, sir!
translation: 我可以开车送您，先生！

source: There’s no need. I do have a favor to ask though.
translation: 不用。不过我确实有件事想请你们帮忙。

source: What is it, Gramps?
translation: 什么事，Gramps？

source: Can you sort these documents and bring them over to the office for me?
translation: 能帮我整理这些文件，再送到办公室吗？

source: It’s a report from Jin about the technical progress… I didn’t have time to read it last night, and this morning I’ve been rushing to get to town.
translation: 这是Jin提交的技术进度报告……昨晚我没时间看，今天早上又一直赶着进城。

source: Hehe, you sure all that techie jargon didn’t just confuse you?
translation: 嘿嘿，你确定不是那些技术术语把你看糊涂了？

source: Hmph. I doubt you’d comprehend it either.
translation: 哼，我怀疑你也看不懂。

source: Fair point, haha!
translation: 说得也是，哈哈！

source: But you can leave those docs to me, Gramps! I know where to put ‘em!
translation: 不过这些文件交给我吧，Gramps！我知道该放在哪里！

source: Thanks. Now if you don’t mind, I really have to go.
translation: 谢谢。如果你们不介意，我真的得走了。

source: Drive safe, sir!
translation: 路上小心，先生！

source: Of course. See you later.
translation: 当然。回头见。

source: *stretches* Hnnn~ Now where were we?
translation: *伸懒腰* 嗯嗯～我们刚才进行到哪里了？

source: Wanna sleep in some more? It seems like everyone else is still down.
translation: 想再睡一会儿吗？其他人好像还没起床。

source: Nah, I’m pretty awake now – Gramps gave me quite the jump scare.
translation: 不了，我现在已经很清醒了——Gramps把我吓得够呛。

source: Well, should we get up then?
translation: 那我们起床吧？

source: Today’s pretty much a vacant day again, isn’t it?
translation: 今天基本又是空闲的一天，对吧？

source: Hmm… The workers are scheduled to arrive tomorrow, so maybe we can prepare for that?
translation: 嗯……工人们计划明天到，也许我们可以提前准备？

source: Oh, good idea Yoshi! If we do all the prep work today, I can cook up something special for them tomorrow!
translation: 哦，好主意，Yoshi！如果今天做好所有准备，明天我就能给他们做些特别的食物！

source: Gotta learn some new tricks in the kitchen if I’m gonna be a chef, am I right?
translation: 既然要当厨师，就得在厨房里多学几招，对吧？

source: Yeah! That’s the spirit, Aiden!
translation: 没错！就是这种精神，Aiden！

source: Though, I gotta drop this stuff by Gramps’ desk first! You can go get started in the kitchen for me, Yoshi!
translation: 不过，我得先把这些东西放到Gramps桌上！Yoshi，你可以先去厨房开始准备！

source: Sure thing!
translation: 没问题！

source: Sheesh… There’s so much stuff on Gramps’ desk… How can he even tell which stack of paper he’s working on?
translation: 真是的……Gramps桌上东西也太多了……他怎么分得清自己正在处理哪一摞文件？

source: And I’m about to add more to the pile too…
translation: 而且我还得再往上加一摞……

source: There we go! Errand finished!
translation: 好了！差事完成！

source: Seriously, this stuff should all be digital by now.
translation: 说真的，这些东西早就该全部数字化了。

source: I mean who even uses a landline and a fax machine nowadays?
translation: 现在到底还有谁会用固定电话和传真机？

source: Since I’m here, I might as well…
translation: 既然都来了，我不如……

source: Ah, you’re here, Aiden! I wondered what was taking so long.
translation: 啊，你来了，Aiden！我还在想你为什么这么久。

source: Oh, I just had to, uhh… do a few chores along the way.
translation: 哦，我只是在路上，呃……顺便做了几件事。

source: You know how Gramps is, his office was a disaster! I straightened it up for him.
translation: 你知道Gramps是什么样，他的办公室乱得一塌糊涂！我替他整理了一下。

source: Haha! I guess I can’t help but tidy up his office whenever I go by there, too.
translation: 哈哈！我每次经过那里，也忍不住帮他收拾办公室。

source: A-Anyway, let me help out with the prep – I can’t let you do everything!
translation: 总、总之，让我也帮忙准备——不能什么都让你来做！

source: *starts chopping*
translation: *开始切菜*

source: Uh? Aren’t you going to wash your hands, first?
translation: 呃？你不先洗手吗？

source: Wha?
translation: 什么？

source: And you forgot to put your apron on.
translation: 而且你忘了穿围裙。

source: O-Oh, right…!
{i}(Hmm… Aiden’s acting a bit strange… I wonder what’s going on?){/i}
translation: {i}（嗯……Aiden表现得有点奇怪……不知道发生了什么？）{/i}

source: {i}(Hmm… Aiden’s acting a bit strange… I wonder what’s going on?){/i}{fast}
translation: {i}（嗯……Aiden表现得有点奇怪……不知道发生了什么？）{/i}{fast}

source: Want to call Mr. Clermont today?
translation: 今天想给Clermont先生打电话吗？

source: S-So Aiden, I was thinking… When do you want to go and call Mr. Clermont today?
translation: 那、那个，Aiden，我在想……你今天什么时候想给Clermont先生打电话？

source: We could do it right now, if you’re ready!
translation: 如果你准备好了，我们现在就可以打！

source: Excited about the offer?
translation: 对这个邀请感到兴奋吗？

source: Excited about Mr. Clermont’s offer?
translation: 你对Clermont先生的邀请感到兴奋吗？

source: Having second thoughts?
translation: 又犹豫了吗？

source: Having second thoughts about Mr. Clermont’s offer?
translation: 你对Clermont先生的邀请又犹豫了吗？

source: Worried about the offer?
translation: 在担心那个邀请吗？

source: Are you worried about Mr. Clermont’s offer?
translation: 你在担心Clermont先生的邀请吗？

source: E-Eh? Where’d that come from?
translation: 诶、诶？怎么突然这么问？

source: O-Oh, it’s nothing, I just thought you were acting different compared to this morning. Is something wrong?
translation: 哦、哦，没什么，我只是觉得你和早上相比有点不一样。出什么事了吗？

source: Nah, I’m fine, Yoshi.
translation: 没有，我没事，Yoshi。

source: Come on, Aiden. You should know by now that I can tell when something’s on your mind.
translation: 别这样，Aiden。你应该知道，只要你有心事，我就看得出来。

source: *sigh* Yeah, you got me. I was thinking about it.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，被你看穿了。我确实在想那件事。

source: If you’re worried about how to talk to Mr. Clermont, I have some good talking points and questions to ask during the call!
translation: 如果你担心不知道怎么和Clermont先生谈，我准备了一些通话时可以说的要点和问题！

source: I did a bunch of interviews for my part-time jobs back in college, so I think I can give you some tips!
translation: 大学时我为兼职参加过很多面试，所以应该能给你一些建议！

source: Hmm… But the thing is… I don’t feel so sure, after thinking about it.
translation: 嗯……但问题是……仔细想过以后，我又没那么确定了。

source: Oh… I thought you made up your mind last night?
translation: 哦……我还以为你昨晚已经下定决心了？

source: I mean, I just got this offer yesterday… Maybe I got myself way too hyped up about it in the moment.
translation: 我是说，我昨天才收到这个邀请……也许当时一时兴奋过头了。

source: I don’t wanna rush the decision. It could be a huge change for me, and you, after all.
translation: 我不想仓促决定。毕竟这可能给我，还有你，带来巨大的改变。

source: Hmm… Do you think it’d help if we ask the others about it? So that it’s not just my opinion?
translation: 嗯……我们问问其他人的看法会不会有帮助？这样就不只有我的意见了。

source: Ehh… I dunno about that…
translation: 呃……我不太确定……

source: Yuri… I already broke a nail doing the laundry… Can I take a break from all of these menial jobs…?
translation: Yuri……我洗衣服都弄断一根指甲了……我能不能暂时别做这些卑微的杂活……？

source: These jobs aren’t menial! You’re gonna work your ass off till you can see how essential these tasks are since—
translation: 这些工作才不卑微！你得拼命干到明白这些任务有多重要，因为——

source: “It’S tHe sAmE jOb yOu wErE bAdMoUtHiNg BaCk ThEn” Fine, fine! I get it… geez…
translation: “这就是你以前贬低过的同一份工作！”好了，好了！我知道了……真是的……

source: See, you’re getting the hang of it~
translation: 看吧，你已经开始上手了～

source: Oh, hey there, you two! Good morning!
translation: 哦，嘿，你们两个！早上好！

source: Hello, Yoshi and Aiden~
translation: 你们好，Yoshi、Aiden～

source: You’re not just in an apron today – what’s the occasion?
translation: 你今天居然不只穿围裙——发生什么了？

source: Ahehe, well it has gotten pretty cold lately…
translation: 啊嘿嘿，最近天气确实挺冷的……

source: Hey… I make sure the food is clean… and tasty~!
translation: 喂……我保证食物既干净……又美味～！

source: It’s okay, Emilia, We’re approved by The Health Inspection Culinary Collective Association or T.H.I.C.C. Ass.
translation: 没关系，Emilia，我们通过了“卫生检查烹饪联合协会”的认证，简称T.H.I.C.C. Ass.。

source: Did you just make that up…?
translation: 这是你刚编出来的吧……？

source: Wh-What? Of course not! That’s a legitimate food safety committee…!
translation: 什、什么？当然不是！那可是合法的食品安全委员会……！

source: And how did you manage to pull that approval off with Aiden over here running around the camp? Did you hide him in the closet?
translation: 有Aiden在营地里到处乱跑，你们是怎么拿到认证的？检查时把他藏进衣柜了吗？

source: I wear clothes during the inspections…
translation: 检查时我会穿衣服……

source: Hihi, you’re not the only one who knows how to get clever with screening applications, Emilia~
translation: 嘻嘻，懂得在审查申请上耍点小聪明的人可不只你，Emilia～

source: G-Gah…!
translation: 呃、呃啊……！

source: *ehem* What brings you two here anyway?
translation: *咳咳* 总之，你们两个来这里做什么？

source: Oh, Emilia and I were grabbing supplies to clean the mess hall thoroughly before the workers arrived.
translation: 哦，Emilia和我来拿些用品，准备在工人到达前彻底打扫食堂。

source: Clean? Wow… Emilia, you’re actually taking stuff off my list.
translation: 打扫？哇……Emilia，你居然真的开始替我分担工作了。

source: It’s not like I have a choice… I’d much rather have a desk job than this.
translation: 我又没得选……比起这个，我宁愿做办公室工作。

source: Speaking of jobs! I heard from Dad that someone got quite the job offer~
translation: 说到工作！我听爸爸说，有人收到了一份相当不错的工作邀请～

source: Is it true? Are you really going to be a pro chef now, Aiden?!
translation: 是真的吗？Aiden，你真的要成为专业厨师了？！

source: Actually, Aiden still hasn’t made up his mind about it.
translation: 其实，Aiden还没有下定决心。

source: I’m appalled to hear that you’d even consider turning it down!
translation: 听说你居然考虑拒绝，我简直震惊！

source: An opportunity as big as this is once in a lifetime!
translation: 这么好的机会一辈子可能只有一次！

source: With someone of Mr. Clermont’s caliber, he’d really put your name out there!
translation: 以Clermont先生的地位，他真的能让你声名远扬！

source: Oh my god, Aiden!! Don’t forget us when you’re famous!
translation: 天哪，Aiden！！成名以后可别忘了我们！

source: And that’s not even mentioning the money – you’d be pulling in almost five figures a month with the clientele he refers!
translation: 这还没算收入呢——靠他介绍的客户，你每个月几乎能赚到五位数！

source: I-I guess that is a lot of cash…
translation: 那、那确实是一大笔钱……

source: *sigh* I remember when my bank account had a hundred thousand just as petty cash…
translation: *叹气* 我还记得以前银行账户里光零花钱就有十万……

source: After losing all that and having to live life so frugally, you really get to see what a difference it makes.
translation: 失去一切、不得不过上节俭生活以后，你才会真正看清金钱能带来多大差别。

source: I’m not trying to be callous here, and I’m sure we all know, but Aiden has never really gotten to experience financial freedom.
translation: 我不是故意冷酷，而且大家应该都知道，Aiden从来没有真正体验过财务自由。

source: Now that you have the chance to change that, the decision here seems so obvious!
translation: 现在你有机会改变这一点，答案不是显而易见吗！

source: I’m a go-getter, so if I were in your shoes, I’d fight for that position!
translation: 我是个积极进取的人，所以换成我，一定会拼命争取这个职位！

source: I’m a go-getter, so if I were in your shoes, I’d fight for that position!{fast}
translation: 我是个积极进取的人，所以换成我，一定会拼命争取这个职位！{fast}

source: She has a point.
translation: 她说得有道理。

source: Emilia’s got a point – it’s such a great opportunity!
translation: Emilia说得有道理——这是个绝佳的机会！

source: Y-Yeah, but there’s more to consider besides just the money…
translation: 是、是啊，但除了钱以外，还有很多事情需要考虑……

source: Maybe that makes it a little bit clearer for Aiden.
translation: 也许这样能让Aiden看得更清楚一点。

source: Maybe that makes things a little bit clearer for you, Aiden?
translation: 也许这样能让你看得更清楚一点，Aiden？

source: There's a lot to consider besides just money.
translation: 除了钱，还有很多事情需要考虑。

source: Well… There’s a lot of things to consider besides just the money, after all…
translation: 这个……毕竟除了钱以外，还有很多事情需要考虑……

source: Aiden is different.
translation: Aiden和你不同。

source: Aiden’s not the same as you though, Emilia.
translation: 但Aiden和你不同，Emilia。

source: Sure, money is important, but there are other things to consider as well.
translation: 金钱当然重要，但也需要考虑其他事情。

source: It’s a JOB! It’s always about the money!
translation: 这是工作！工作当然就是为了钱！

source: Emilia, not everything is about that! Sometimes it’s about your passion and what makes you happy in the long run!
translation: Emilia，不是一切都只看钱！有时还要看你的热情，以及什么能让你长久地快乐！

source: You wouldn’t wanna work in a job that pays you well but makes you depressed and upset the whole time, would you?
translation: 你也不想做一份工资虽高，却让自己始终压抑难过的工作，对吧？

source: Either way, I understand Aiden! I know he isn’t used to that kind of environment, so it makes sense if he needs more time to decide!
translation: 不管怎样，我理解Aiden！我知道他不习惯那种环境，所以需要更多时间决定也很合理！

source: You’re wasting time if you ask me~ If you don’t want it, teach me how to cook and I’ll gladly take your spot!
translation: 要我说，你只是在浪费时间～如果你不想要，就教我做饭，我很乐意顶替你！

source: Oh, please! You’d manage to burn cereal if we let you in the kitchen!
translation: 哦，得了吧！要是让你进厨房，你连麦片都能烧焦！

source: Don’t listen to Emilia, Aiden. She doesn’t know what she’s talking about.
translation: 别听Emilia的，Aiden。她根本不知道自己在说什么。

source: Now if you’ll excuse us, I’m gonna take this ‘go-getter’ and get her started mopping!
translation: 现在失陪了，我要带这个“积极进取的人”去拖地！

source: H-Hey, let go of me!
translation: 喂、喂，放开我！

source: Hey, are you alright?
translation: 嘿，你没事吧？

source: Yeah, what Emilia and Yuri said just got me thinking…
translation: 没事，只是Emilia和Yuri的话让我陷入了思考……

source: Take it with a grain of salt, Aiden. I’m sure they’re just sharing their opinions based on their experiences.
translation: 别全盘照收，Aiden。她们只是根据自己的经历分享看法。

source: Yeah, I guess you’re right…
translation: 是啊，我想你说得对……

source: Anyway, why don’t we get back to work? Let’s cook our meals for today while we’re at it.
translation: 总之，我们继续工作吧？顺便把今天的饭也做好。

source: Oh right, the guys will probably be up soon.
translation: 哦，对，其他人应该很快就会起床。

source: I’ll go ahead and preheat the oven.
translation: 我先去预热烤箱。

source: {i}As I worked with Aiden, he stayed quiet and lost in his thoughts the entire time.{/i}
translation: {i}和Aiden一起工作时，他始终沉默不语，陷在自己的思绪里。{/i}

source: {i}It’s just like back at the hotel… He keeps trying to change the topic and act as if everything is fine.{/i}
translation: {i}这就像在酒店时一样……他总想转移话题，装作一切都好。{/i}

source: {i}I knew he couldn’t get the advice about the offer off his mind.{/i}
translation: {i}我知道，他始终无法停止思考大家对那份邀请的建议。{/i}

source: {i}A part of me hopes that I’m wrong, and just overthinking it.{/i}
translation: {i}我心里有一部分希望自己错了，只是想得太多。{/i}

source: {i}Shortly after we finished cooking, we headed over to the construction site to bring everyone lunch and see what else we could do.{/i}
translation: {i}做完饭不久，我们带着午餐前往工地，看看还能帮上什么忙。{/i}

source: Don’t swing the hammer that hard, you dumbass! You’re bending all the nails!
translation: 别那么用力抡锤子，蠢货！钉子全被你砸弯了！

source: How the hell else am I supposed to get them in, then?!
translation: 不这么砸，我他妈还能怎么把它们钉进去？！

source: I’ve been showing you how but you keep ignoring me! Seriously, you have the attention span of a goldfish!
translation: 我一直在教你，可你根本不听！说真的，你的注意力比金鱼还短！

source: What did you call me?! Take that back, Dynamite!
translation: 你叫我什么？！收回那句话，Dynamite！

source: *whispers* Now, kiss.
translation: *低语* 现在，亲一个。

source: Geez, those two have been bickering nonstop since we started.
translation: 真是的，从开工起他们两个就一直吵个不停。

source: I don’t mind… I will go down with this ship…
translation: 我不介意……我会和这艘船一起沉下去……

source: *sigh* I probably should’ve made Yoichi work on something else, huh…?
translation: *叹气* 我大概该让Yoichi去做别的工作，对吧……？

source: How about breaking down the scrap materials?
translation: 让他去拆碎废料怎么样？

source: Ooh, good idea, Dar!
translation: 哦，好主意，Dar！

source: Hey, Yoichi! I’ve got something more fun for you to do!
translation: 嘿，Yoichi！我有件更有趣的事让你做！

source: See that pile of broken bricks over there? I want you to smash ’em to smaller pieces!
translation: 看到那边那堆碎砖了吗？把它们砸成更小的块！

source: Hell yeah! That’s more like it!
translation: 太他妈好了！这才像话！

source: Ugh. Good riddance.
translation: 呃，终于走了。

source: Hey, guys, take a little break! We brought lunch!
translation: 嘿，各位，休息一下吧！我们带午餐来了！

source: Alright! I’m starving!
translation: 太好了！我快饿死了！

source: That better not be some green, healthy crap you’re feeding us.
translation: 你们拿来的最好不是什么绿色健康垃圾。

source: I made some burgers actually! Thought you guys need the extra protein from all that manual labor!
translation: 其实我做了汉堡！你们干了这么多体力活，应该需要额外补充蛋白质！

source: I’m surprised to see you here, Jin. Are you helping with the repairs?
translation: 真没想到会在这里看到你，Jin。你也在帮忙维修吗？

source: Y-Yeah… I stopped by after I finished up some coding.
translation: 是、是啊……写完一些代码后，我就过来帮忙了。

source: Since our workout yesterday, Jin wanted to continue being more physically active.
translation: 昨天锻炼以后，Jin想继续多参加些体力活动。

source: Building those muscles, eh? Good for you!
translation: 想练出肌肉，对吧？很好！

source: Scrawny muscles! You’ll look like Dynamite over here!
translation: 还“瘦巴巴的肌肉”呢！再练下去，你就要变成旁边这个Dynamite了！

source: What’s wrong with that? I’m hot!
translation: 那有什么不好？我很性感！

source: Blech, you’re just malnourished.
translation: 呸，你只是营养不良。

source: You don’t even know what that word means.
translation: 你根本不知道那个词是什么意思。

source: I can only dream that I’d have a body as nice as any of you guys…
translation: 我只能梦想有一天能拥有像你们任何一个人那么好的身材……

source: Haha, it takes time, Jin! You don’t build muscle in a day, after all.
translation: 哈哈，这需要时间，Jin！肌肉不是一天就能练出来的。

source: I told him that too, but he’s determined to get fit for some cosplay!
translation: 我也这么告诉过他，可他决心为了角色扮演练好身材！

source: Oh, you cosplay, Jin?
translation: 哦，你也玩角色扮演吗，Jin？

source: I’ve always looked at them but never tried it myself.
translation: 我一直都在看别人玩，但自己从没试过。

source: Hey, Buttcheeks! Where’s the ketchup?!
translation: 喂，Buttcheeks！番茄酱在哪里？！

source: Oh, woops, looks like I left it in the messhall!
translation: 哦，糟糕，看来我把它落在食堂了！

source: Ugh! What was the point of bringing all this out here then?!
translation: 呃！那把这些东西全带出来还有什么意义？！

source: Haha, sorry, Yoichi! It must’ve slipped my mind.
translation: 哈哈，抱歉，Yoichi！我肯定是一不小心忘了。

source: You can go and get it if you want.
translation: 你想吃的话，可以自己去拿。

source: Fine! But I’m getting some marshmallows too!
translation: 好！不过我还要拿些棉花糖！

source: He’s not coming back, is he?
translation: 他不会回来了，对吧？

source: Goodt, more for ursh!
translation: 好啊，那我们能多吃点！

source: *sigh* Chew your food well before talking, Taiga. You might choke.
translation: *叹气* 先把食物嚼好再说话，Taiga。小心噎着。

source: *gulp* Can’t help it. Aiden’s burgers are bajillion times better than the fast food ones I usually get.
translation: *咽下* 没办法。Aiden的汉堡比我平时吃的快餐好吃亿万倍。

source: I agree – I don’t think I could ever go back to my old diet after being here.
translation: 我同意——在这里吃过以后，我觉得自己再也回不去以前的饮食了。

source: Thanks for the food, Aiden. It’s delicious as always.
translation: 谢谢你的食物，Aiden。一如既往地美味。

source: You know, you could totally start your own restaurant and I’d be your loyal customer with how good your food is.
translation: 知道吗，以你的厨艺完全可以开自己的餐厅，我一定会成为忠实顾客。

source: A-Ahehe… You guys always flatter me too much.
translation: 啊、啊嘿嘿……你们总是把我夸得太过头了。

source: I’m being serious here! If you made a career out of your talent, you’d be really successful!
translation: 我是认真的！如果把这份才华变成事业，你一定会非常成功！

source: I can already see it, “Camp Buddy, an origin story of where a master chef started his culinary journey”.
translation: 我已经能想象了：“伙伴营——一代名厨开启烹饪之旅的起源故事”。

source: ‘Master Chef Aiden’ has such a nice ring to it! Don’t you think so?
translation: “Aiden大厨”听起来多好啊！你不觉得吗？

source: ‘Master Chef Aiden’ has such a nice ring to it! Don’t you think so?{fast}
translation: “Aiden大厨”听起来多好啊！你不觉得吗？{fast}

source: He actually got an offer.
translation: 其实他已经收到邀请了。

source: In fact, before Mr. Clermont left yesterday, he actually offered Aiden a chance at a professional certification to be a chef.
translation: 事实上，Clermont先生昨天离开前，给了Aiden取得专业厨师认证的机会。

source: A-Ah, you didn’t have to tell them about that, Yoshi…!
translation: 啊、啊，你不用告诉他们的，Yoshi……！

source: I think so too. Aiden could really make it big out there.
translation: 我也这么认为。Aiden在外面真的能闯出一番事业。

source: He already is.
translation: 他已经是了。

source: He already kinda is.
translation: 他其实已经差不多是了。

source: Ehh… It’s not official without the title.
translation: 呃……没有头衔就不算正式。

source: Hm? What do you mean?
translation: 嗯？什么意思？

source: Ah, well… Before Mr. Clermont left yesterday, he sorta gave me a shot at being a pro chef.
translation: 啊，这个……Clermont先生昨天离开前，算是给了我一个成为专业厨师的机会。

source: If that's what Aiden wants.
translation: 如果那是Aiden想要的。

source: If that’s what Aiden wants, there’s actually a chance.
translation: 如果那是Aiden想要的，他确实有这个机会。

source: Ehh… I’m still thinking about it.
translation: 呃……我还在考虑。

source: Whoa, that’s great news, Aiden! Congrats!
translation: 哇，这是个好消息，Aiden！恭喜！

source: I’m sure you said yes, right? We could be co-workers! I mean… have the same boss at least, haha!
translation: 你肯定答应了吧？我们可以成为同事！我是说……至少会有同一个老板，哈哈！

source: Aren’t we already?
translation: 我们现在不就是吗？

source: Oh yeah… But you guys get my point! A job at Clermont Inc. is really as prestigious as it gets! It’ll be really good for your resume!
translation: 哦，对……但你们明白我的意思！在Clermont公司工作可以说是无上荣耀！对你的履历也非常有帮助！

source: Aiden hasn’t said yes yet, actually. He’s still giving it some time to think about.
translation: 其实Aiden还没有答应，他还想再花些时间考虑。

source: What’s holding you back, Aiden?
translation: 是什么让你犹豫，Aiden？

source: W-Well… I’m just feeling kinda pressured ’bout the whole thing.
translation: 这、这个……我只是觉得整件事带来了很大压力。

source: Huh? Why? Isn’t that already the same thing you’re doing here?
translation: 嗯？为什么？那不就是你在这里做的同一种工作吗？

source: Not at all, especially if we’re talking about restaurants.
translation: 完全不同，尤其是在餐厅工作。

source: Yeah, Darius and I designed a few industrial kitchens before and we know that it gets pretty hectic in there.
translation: 是啊，Darius和我以前设计过几座商用厨房，我们知道里面会有多么忙乱。

source: You make food to order and there’s always people to feed as long as the shop sign says open.
translation: 顾客点什么就得做什么，而且只要店还开着，就总有人等着吃饭。

source: Yeah… Unlike here at the camp, I can have a meal planned for the week to prep and cook everything in advance.
translation: 是啊……不像在营地里，我可以提前规划一周的菜单，把一切都事先准备并做好。

source: Don’t get me wrong, what you’re doing now is just as labor intensive, but it’s the stress factor that’s often worse.
translation: 别误会，你现在的工作同样辛苦，但餐厅里的精神压力往往更大。

source: Just like most professions out there.
translation: 和外面大多数职业一样。

source: I guess the work environment could make or break it too. I get along better with everyone here at Camp Buddy than anywhere else I’ve worked.
translation: 工作环境也可能决定成败。在伙伴营里，我和大家相处得比以前任何工作场所都好。

source: At least, post-Emilia filler arc…
translation: 至少，在Emilia过渡篇之后是这样……

source: So, yeah! We totally get why you feel iffy about it! All that pressure would make me boil over too!
translation: 所以，是啊！我们完全理解你为什么犹豫！那么大的压力也会让我崩溃！

source: Come on, you guys. You’re not supposed to discourage him.
translation: 行了，各位。你们不该打击他的信心。

source: A-Ah, sorry! I wasn’t trying to…!
translation: 啊、啊，抱歉！我不是故意的……！

source: Like yeah, a new opportunity is scary, but you’ll never know unless you try.
translation: 没错，新机会会让人害怕，但不去尝试就永远不会知道结果。

source: And if you're worried about big changes, take it from me, it's much better on the other side.
translation: 如果你担心巨大的改变，相信我的亲身经历，跨过去以后会好得多。

source: I know my situation was different, but if I hadn't taken that chance I'd have never been here with you guys, and made all my friends.
translation: 我知道自己的情况不同，但如果当初没抓住机会，我就不会来到这里和你们相遇，也不会交到这么多朋友。

source: Th-That's true... It's because I pushed myself out of my comfort zone that I met all of you too.
translation: 这、这倒是真的……正因为我逼自己走出舒适区，才遇见了你们。

source: So maybe taking risks isn't so bad...?
translation: 所以冒点险也许并不是坏事……？

source: Yeah! Once you get the hang of it, learn certain skills and how things work, it’s gonna get easier!
translation: 没错！等你掌握诀窍、学会技能并熟悉运作方式，一切都会变容易！

source: Aiden is tough and diligent. He can take anything you throw at him and make things work.
translation: Aiden既坚强又勤奋。无论遇到什么，他都能想办法应对。

source: Sounds to me like the answer’s pretty obvious then.
translation: 听起来答案已经很明显了。

source: W-Well…
translation: 这、这个……

source: Hey! I can’t find the freakin’ mallows! Where’d you guys hide them?!
translation: 喂！我找不到该死的棉花糖！你们藏到哪里去了？！

source: Oh, look at that. He came back after all.
translation: 哦，瞧瞧。他终究还是回来了。

source: Can’t you use your dog nose to sniff them out?
translation: 你不能用狗鼻子把它们闻出来吗？

source: Shut up, Dynamite! I wasn’t talking to you!
translation: 闭嘴，Dynamite！我没在和你说话！

source: I have some of my burger left if you’re still hungry, Yoichi… I’m already full.
translation: 如果你还饿，我这里剩下一些汉堡，Yoichi……我已经吃饱了。

source: Score!
translation: 太棒了！

source: What were you going to say, Aiden? We got interrupted.
translation: 你刚才想说什么，Aiden？我们被打断了。

source: O-Oh, nothing, really!
translation: 哦、哦，真的没什么！

source: A-Actually, I just remembered, I gotta see if the laundry’s dry on the line!
translation: 其、其实我刚想起来，得去看看晾衣绳上的衣服干了没有！

source: See ya later, guys…!
translation: 回头见，各位……！

source: Huh? What’s wrong with Buttcheeks?
translation: 嗯？Buttcheeks怎么了？

source: You talked over him, dumbass.
translation: 你打断他了，蠢货。

source: Also, he’s drying stuff outdoors… in winter? Wouldn’t it just get frozen?
translation: 而且，他在冬天把衣服晾在外面……不会直接冻住吗？

source: Ah, excuse me, guys. I need to catch up with Aiden.
translation: 啊，失陪一下，各位。我得去追Aiden。

source: Hey, Aiden... What are you doing here?
translation: 嘿，Aiden……你在这里做什么？

source: Ah, Yoshi…!
translation: 啊，Yoshi……！

source: Are you alright…? You’ve been acting off for a while now.
translation: 你还好吗……？你已经有一阵子不太对劲了。

source: Wh-What? Am I?
translation: 什、什么？有吗？

source: Yeah… I mean, you were just trying to avoid the conversation…
translation: 有……我是说，你刚才明显在逃避那场谈话……

source: Look, I know you’re getting frustrated today with all the talk about the offer especially when you’re still thinking about it, but…
translation: 听着，我知道大家今天一直谈论那份邀请，让还在考虑的你很烦躁，可是……

source: Look, I know you’re getting frustrated today with all the talk about the offer especially when you’re still thinking about it, but…{fast}
translation: 听着，我知道大家今天一直谈论那份邀请，让还在考虑的你很烦躁，可是……{fast}

source: You're making everyone worry.
translation: 你让大家都很担心。

source: You’re going to make everyone worry.
translation: 你会让大家都担心的。

source: Obviously, you're upset.
translation: 你显然很难过。

source: You're obviously upset, Aiden.
translation: 你显然很难过，Aiden。

source: Tell me what's wrong.
translation: 告诉我发生了什么。

source: You don't have to bottle it up.
translation: 你不必把一切憋在心里。

source: You don't have to bottle up what you're feeling and deal with it on your own.
translation: 你不必把感受全憋在心里，独自面对。

source: I need you to tell me what's on your mind.
translation: 我需要你告诉我心里在想什么。

source: Can you at least tell me what’s on your mind right now?
translation: 至少告诉我你现在心里在想什么，好吗？

source: I’ll listen…
translation: 我会听着……

source: *sigh* I…
translation: *叹气* 我……

source: I really don’t know, if I should take it or not, Yoshi…
translation: 我真的不知道自己该不该接受，Yoshi……

source: What’s with the change of heart…? I thought you were already sure?
translation: 为什么突然改变心意……？我以为你已经确定了？

source: You were even so excited last night… especially when you were talking about your dad…
translation: 昨晚你甚至那么兴奋……尤其是谈到爸爸的时候……

source: Yeah… I know…
translation: 是啊……我知道……

source: Are you worried it'd be difficult to adjust and learn the new skills? Or is it about the environment, like back at the hotel?
translation: 你是担心难以适应和学习新技能吗？还是像酒店那次一样，担心那里的环境？

source: If you want, we can call Mr. Clermont right now and it’ll help clear your doubts!
translation: 如果你愿意，我们现在就可以给Clermont先生打电话，让他帮你消除疑虑！

source: Without knowing the details, it’s no wonder you’re feeling anxious and hesitant, so let’s fix that.
translation: 不了解细节，难怪你会焦虑犹豫，所以我们来解决这个问题。

source: N-No it’s not that… I just—
translation: 不、不是那个原因……我只是——

source: I understand you’re feeling pressured about the whole thing, but I promise that you’ll be fine!
translation: 我知道整件事让你很有压力，但我保证你会没事的！

source: I’m here to help you!
translation: 我会帮助你！

source: Can we stop talking about the damn offer for one minute?!
translation: 我们能不能有一分钟别再谈那该死的邀请了？！

source: Everyone’s been bringing it up nonstop, all day long! It’s driving me insane!
translation: 所有人一整天都在不停提这件事！快把我逼疯了！

source: I already told you I need more time to think about it!
translation: 我已经说过，自己需要更多时间考虑！

source: And I can’t think straight with all of you being so damn persistent!!
translation: 你们全都这么纠缠不休，我根本没法好好思考！！

source: I-I’m sorry, Aiden… I didn’t mean to be…
translation: 对、对不起，Aiden……我不是故意要……

source: I’m just really confused with what changed all of a sudden…
translation: 我只是很困惑，究竟是什么让你突然改变了……

source: It’s because I already called Mr. Clermont…
translation: 因为我已经给Clermont先生打过电话了……

source: Wh-What…? When?
translation: 什、什么……？什么时候？

source: When I went to the office this morning…
translation: 今天早上我去办公室的时候……

source: I told him I was interested in the whole thing… and then he told me the details…
translation: 我告诉他自己对这件事感兴趣……然后他告诉了我具体情况……

source: What did he say?
translation: 他说了什么？

source: To get the certification I need, I have to enroll in the training course for it.
translation: 为了取得需要的认证，我必须参加相应的培训课程。

source: He’s gonna sponsor everything, from my accommodations to the actual scholarships…
translation: 他会资助一切，从住宿到实际的奖学金……

source: Oh, then that’s good news…! Isn’t it…?
translation: 哦，那不是好消息吗……！对吧……？

source: The catch is… it’d take at least two years…
translation: 问题是……至少需要两年……

source: That’s normal, though… it takes time to hone your craft! It’s what I went through to get my degree!
translation: 不过这很正常……磨炼技艺需要时间！我取得学位时也经历了同样的过程！

source: Exactly… Just like what you had to do, I’d have to leave, too… and go abroad…
translation: 没错……就像你当初一样，我也必须离开……去国外……

source: That means I won’t get to come back here ’til I finish the whole thing…
translation: 这意味着在完成整个课程前，我都不能回到这里……

source: And who knows, once I get the title and all, I’d have to work elsewhere too…
translation: 而且谁知道呢，等我取得头衔以后，也必须去别的地方工作……

source: But that’s the whole point, right? It would be a waste if you work that hard and only end up back at Camp Buddy…
translation: 但这不正是重点吗？如果那么努力以后只是回到伙伴营，那不是浪费了吗……

source: If that’s what it takes to finally pursue your lifelong dream, I’m sure it’d be worth it!
translation: 如果这是追求毕生梦想必须付出的代价，我相信一定值得！

source: I’m turning it down.
translation: 我要拒绝。

source: I don’t want to leave…
translation: 我不想离开……

source: Wait, I don’t understand… Why?!
translation: 等等，我不明白……为什么？！

source: I’d rather stay here… with you…
translation: 我宁愿留在这里……和你在一起……

source: Aiden… It’s not like we’d never see each other again.
translation: Aiden……我们又不是再也见不到彼此了。

source: Remember when I left to study? We made a promise that night on the rooftop that I’d come back. And I did!
translation: 还记得我离开去上学时吗？那晚我们在屋顶约定，我一定会回来。而我做到了！

source: This is basically the same thing, but it’s your turn this time!
translation: 这基本是同一回事，只不过这次轮到你了！

source: And besides, I’m sure I can find a way to see you every once in a while, and you—
translation: 而且，我相信自己能想办法偶尔去见你，而你——

source: It’s not gonna be the same…!
translation: 那不会一样……！

source: It’s not gonna be the same…!{fast}
translation: 那不会一样……！{fast}

source: It's for your own good!
translation: 这是为了你好！

source: I know it may not be as ideal and comfortable as you wanted it to be, but… it’s for your own good!
translation: 我知道这可能不像你希望的那样理想舒适，可是……这是为了你好！

source: There's a way to make it happen!
translation: 一定有办法实现！

source: Look, what I’m saying is, there’s a way we can solve what you’re worried about and achieve your dreams at the same time! A middle ground.
translation: 听着，我的意思是，一定有办法既解决你的担忧，又同时实现梦想！找到一个折中方案。

source: I know it's a lot...
translation: 我知道这很难接受……

source: I know it sounds overwhelming, but it'd be worth it in the end, I'm sure!
translation: 我知道听起来令人不知所措，但我相信最终一定值得！

source: I know you're afraid...
translation: 我知道你害怕……

source: I understand why you’d be afraid of something like this, but I think it'll be worth it in the long run!
translation: 我理解你为什么害怕这样的事情，但长远来看，我认为一定值得！

source: Don’t let me be the reason you stop reaching for your dream!
translation: 别让我成为你放弃追逐梦想的原因！

source: Yoshi…! The more you corner me like this, the more I don’t want to!
translation: Yoshi……！你越这样逼我，我就越不想接受！

source: Yoshi…! The more you corner me like this, the more I don’t want to!{fast}
translation: Yoshi……！你越这样逼我，我就越不想接受！{fast}

source: Don't be so shallow!
translation: 别这么目光短浅！

source: Don’t be so shallow, Aiden!
translation: 别这么目光短浅，Aiden！

source: Sh-Shallow?!
translation: 目、目光短浅？！

source: I'm not forcing you!
translation: 我没有逼你！

source: But I’m not forcing you, Aiden! I’m just trying to—
translation: 但我没有逼你，Aiden！我只是想——

source: I'm only thinking of what's best for you!
translation: 我只是在为你考虑！

source: But I’m only thinking of what’s best for you, Aiden!
translation: 但我只是在为你考虑，Aiden！

source: B-Best for me?!
translation: 为、为我考虑？！

source: You can't just give up either!
translation: 你也不能就这样放弃！

source: Wh-What kind of reasoning is that? You can’t just give up, Aiden!
translation: 这、这算什么理由？你不能就这样放弃，Aiden！

source: B-But I’m not giving up…!
translation: 可、可我没有放弃……！

source: This just proves you don’t understand what I had to go through…!
translation: 这只证明你根本不了解我经历过什么……！

source: Why are you even pushing this so hard?!
translation: 你为什么非要这么逼我？！

source: I thought you told me that I was already good enough…?
translation: 你不是说过，现在的我已经足够好了吗……？

source: That I didn’t need to be more than what I am today…
translation: 说我不需要再变成比现在更了不起的人……

source: A-Aiden, th-that’s not what I meant… I-I just thought the time we’d be apart would be worth it for—
translation: 艾、Aiden，我、我不是那个意思……我只是觉得我们暂时分开的时间值得用来——

source: That’s easy for you to say, Yoshi! You’re the one who left me in the past, so how would you know anyway?!
translation: 你当然说得轻松，Yoshi！过去是你离开了我，你又怎么会明白？！

source: {i}Watching Aiden leave, I couldn’t even stop him… I was too stunned to say anything else…{/i}
translation: {i}看着Aiden离开，我甚至无法阻止他……我震惊得再也说不出话……{/i}

source: {i}Right away, I began to regret pushing Aiden, despite knowing how badly he’s been bothered today…{/i}
translation: {i}我立刻开始后悔。明知Aiden今天一直深受困扰，我却还在逼迫他……{/i}

source: {i}Hearing the pain and frustration in his voice, I feel like I failed Aiden… Especially since there’s something about him that I don’t understand even after all these years.{/i}
translation: {i}听到他声音里的痛苦和沮丧，我觉得自己辜负了Aiden……尤其是这么多年过去，我依然有不了解他的地方。{/i}

source: Aiden… Where are you…?
translation: Aiden……你在哪里……？

source: Yoshinori…?
translation: Yoshinori……？

source: Sir Goro…!
translation: Goro先生……！

source: I just got back. Are you alright…? You look troubled…
translation: 我刚回来。你还好吗……？看起来心事重重……

source: I-I’m sorry, sir… I was just looking for Aiden… He ran off and I can’t find him…
translation: 对、对不起，先生……我正在找Aiden……他跑掉了，我找不到他……

source: Huh? What happened?
translation: 嗯？发生了什么？

source: We… had an argument a while ago, and he left before we could properly resolve it…
translation: 我们……刚才吵了一架，还没能好好解决，他就离开了……

source: Really? You two almost never argue… Mind if I ask what was it about?
translation: 真的吗？你们两个几乎从不争吵……介意告诉我为什么吗？

source: Aiden was worried about the offer from Mr. Clermont, and everyone tried to give advice when they found out.
translation: Aiden在担心Clermont先生的邀请，大家知道后都试着给他建议。

source: It only made him more anxious, so I tried to motivate him to accept it.
translation: 这只让他更加焦虑，于是我试着鼓励他接受邀请。

source: But he ultimately decided not to take it, just because he’d be separated from Camp Buddy… and me…
translation: 可他最终决定拒绝，只因为他会离开伙伴营……还有我……

source: I wanted him to realize that he can finally achieve the dream he wanted for so long…
translation: 我想让他明白，自己终于可以实现长久以来的梦想……

source: And that he shouldn’t turn it down just because he’s afraid of the future…
translation: 他不该仅仅因为害怕未来就拒绝……

source: But the way I handled it only made things worse.
translation: 可我的处理方式只让事情变得更糟。

source: It just doesn’t make sense why he’d give up like that…
translation: 我不明白他为什么会那样放弃……

source: I’ve been with him long enough to know he’s the kind of person who always perseveres no matter what…
translation: 我和他相处得够久，知道无论发生什么，他总会坚持到底……

source: So why did something like this make him crumble?
translation: 为什么这样的事情却让他崩溃了？

source: Aiden must have a reason that stems from something much deeper, Yoshinori…
translation: Aiden一定有更深层的原因，Yoshinori……

source: If pursuing his passion would mean he’d be away from all of us, and that was enough for him to turn away from his dream…
translation: 如果追求热爱意味着要离开我们，而这足以让他放弃梦想……

source: Then he must be afraid of being alone again…
translation: 那么，他一定是害怕再次孤身一人……

source: After all, we all know what happened with his father…
translation: 毕竟，我们都知道他父亲身上发生了什么……

source: …Yes, sir.
translation: ……是的，先生。

source: None of us were with Aiden when Andre passed…
translation: Andre去世时，我们谁都没陪在Aiden身边……

source: I’m sure you can imagine how difficult that must’ve been to handle on his own…
translation: 你一定能想象，他独自承受这一切有多艰难……

source: As much as we wish we could’ve been there for him, we were all on our own separate paths after the first term.
translation: 尽管我们都希望当时能陪着他，可第一期结束后，大家都走上了各自的道路。

source: After you left for your studies, Aiden and Andre had to leave too.
translation: 你离开去求学后，Aiden和Andre也不得不离开。

source: Wh-What…? I-I didn’t know that…
translation: 什、什么……？我、我不知道……

source: I thought all along that Aiden stayed at Camp Buddy until his dad passed away.
translation: 我一直以为Aiden留在伙伴营，直到他父亲去世。

source: Hmm… It seems Aiden kept that from you then…
translation: 嗯……看来Aiden对你隐瞒了这件事……

source: I don’t have any right to talk about his personal life to others, but I think it would help you understand better if you knew how things happened…
translation: 我无权向别人谈论他的私生活，但如果知道事情的经过，或许能帮助你更好地理解他……

source: Once the term was over, Andre began struggling with the work around camp due to an illness.
translation: 那一期结束后，Andre因为疾病，开始难以应付营地里的工作。

source: I knew about his health from when he applied to the camp, but he wanted to keep it hidden from everyone.
translation: 他申请来营地时，我就知道他的健康状况，但他希望向所有人保密。

source: It didn't affect his ability to work at first, but eventually he needed medical treatment.
translation: 一开始这并不影响工作，但后来他必须接受治疗。

source: He didn't have enough money to afford all the expenses, so I insisted on contributing to help him.
translation: 他没有足够的钱承担全部费用，所以我坚持出钱帮助他。

source: His condition continued to worsen until he could no longer work at the camp, and Aiden focused on both caring for him and taking over his job.
translation: 他的病情持续恶化，直到无法继续在营地工作，而Aiden既要照顾他，又接替了他的工作。

source: Even though I offered for them to continue staying at the camp and helping with their bills, Andre ultimately decided it was best for he and Aiden to no longer continue to burden the camp, so they left.
translation: 尽管我提出让他们继续住在营地，并帮忙支付账单，Andre最终还是认为他和Aiden不该继续给营地添负担，于是他们离开了。

source: I'll never forget the gratitude in his smile and the hopefulness in his face, so I respected his decision and let them go.
translation: 我永远忘不了他笑容里的感激和脸上的希望，所以尊重了他的决定，让他们离开。

source: That was the last time I heard from him…
translation: 那是我最后一次得到他的消息……

source: I can't believe I didn't know about this... How were they able to find work or a place to stay after they left with Andre being sick?
translation: 真不敢相信我对此一无所知……Andre病着，他们离开后怎么找到工作和住处的？

source: That... I'm not sure. All we know is how things ended up.
translation: 这个……我不确定。我们只知道最终的结果。

source: But the reason I'm telling you this is to give you a different perspective on why Aiden might have made the decision he did.
translation: 但我告诉你这些，是想让你从另一个角度理解Aiden为什么会做出那个决定。

source: Knowing how much Aiden endured in his past will help you understand his actions today.
translation: 知道Aiden过去承受过多少，会帮助你理解他今天的行为。

source: Knowing how much Aiden endured in his past will help you understand his actions today.{fast}
translation: 知道Aiden过去承受过多少，会帮助你理解他今天的行为。{fast}

source: I can still change his mind.
translation: 我还是能改变他的想法。

source: But the past shouldn’t affect his future... There must be a way I can still change his mind!
translation: 但过去不该影响他的未来……一定还有办法能改变他的想法！

source: Just remember to not lose track of what matters most, Yoshinori.
translation: 只要记住，别忘了什么才是最重要的，Yoshinori。

source: Now, go find him… I’m sure he’s waiting for you
translation: 现在去找他吧……我相信他正等着你。

source: It's up to him to decide.
translation: 应该由他自己决定。

source: That’s right. No matter my opinion, it's up to him to decide.
translation: 没错。无论我怎么想，都应该由他自己决定。

source: What you say to him still matters, Yoshinori.
translation: 你对他说的话依然很重要，Yoshinori。

source: I'll support him no matter what.
translation: 无论如何，我都会支持他。

source: That’s right... I need to support him no matter what choice he makes.
translation: 没错……无论他做出什么选择，我都需要支持他。

source: Now, go find Aiden, Yoshinori… I’m sure he’s waiting for you.
translation: 现在去找Aiden吧，Yoshinori……我相信他正等着你。

source: His happiness is what matters.
translation: 他的幸福才是最重要的。

source: That’s right… Aiden’s happiness is what matters the most!
translation: 没错……Aiden的幸福才是最重要的！

source: I’m going to do whatever it takes for him!
translation: 为了他，我会不惜一切！

source: Right…! Thank you, sir!
translation: 对……！谢谢您，先生！
